title: Stand and deliver with Feedback Sports
content:
Cyclist
Stand and deliver with Feedback Sports

Let’s face it, bike maintenance isn’t the most glamorous of topics, but when you’ve spent thousands of pounds on a high-end bike, investing in high-quality tools and equipment to keep it in fine fettle and running smoothly really is a no-brainer. 

Since 2004, Feedback Sports has been producing professional-grade bike stands, tools, storage products and other cycling hardware with exactly that notion in mind. Its products are trusted by team mechanics at the highest level of pro cycling, yet the company is equally focused on providing value, portability and durability for everyday riders too.

Feedback Sports was started in Colorado by CEO Doug Hudson, who had a background in engineering and fibre optics and had already set up a successful messenger bag and lifestyle brand. His true love was cycling, however, and this passion would soon give him a new calling: to create a range of precision cycling products aimed at dedicated riders, racers and skilled mechanics. Together with his wife, Lisa, Doug got to work on the company’s first product, the Feedback Sports Alpine Digital Scale, and from there things have only grown.

Made for cyclists

Today the company produces a wide array of products that have been researched, designed and developed specifically for cyclists. Its repair stands are robust yet lightweight, and are designed to be portable and easy to travel with. Its bike-specific tools are a mechanic’s dream, combining smart, precise design using premium materials with superior functionality and ergonomic ease of use. Its storage solutions range from free-standing options that keep your bike easy to access or wall-mounted solutions if space is at a premium.

The Feedback Sports product range continues to expand, informed by feedback from pro team mechanics and everyday riders alike, yet Doug and Lisa’s love of cycling remains at the company’s heart. It’s this commitment that has guided Feedback Sports for the past 22 years, and will continue to drive it forwards in the future. 

The right tool for the job

Essential items for every cyclist from the extensive Feedback Sports product line

Sprint Bike Repair Stand

£360 | Buy now

If you’re serious about bike maintenance, a decent repair stand is a must. The Sprint Bike Repair Stand attaches to your bike’s dropouts to keep its weight centred over the stand’s tripod base, yet weighs just 5.4kg and folds down to an impressively compact footprint for ease of transport. Its 360-degree rotating platform ensures quick and easy access to any part of the frame, and the rubber-coated end caps on the tripod’s legs keep the stand stable at all times. It comes with adapters for quick release and thru-axle standards, and is backed by a three-year warranty.

Modular T-Handle Kit

£220 | Buy now

This fetching toolkit houses a set of ten colour-coded wrenches – seven hex and three Torx – in a space-saving tool roll. The removable lateral bars allow you to mix and match the driver sizes, while the handles can be set to three different positions to make it easier to access hard-to-reach places. The CNC-machined tool bodies feel solid in the hand yet their compact length ensures the kit remains lightweight and portable. The tool roll is easily integrated into Feedback Sports’ larger Team Edition case, or can be wall-mounted on a peg board.

Range Click Torque Wrench

£120 | Buy now 

Durable, versatile and capable, the Range Click Torque Wrench may well be the last torque wrench you ever buy. It measures torque between 2-14Nm, adjustable in 0.17Nm increments, while the dual-sided window display scale caters for right- or left-handed use. The shop-quality fit and plastic-free head and handle ensure a solid and secure feel in the hand, and the unit comes with 13 high-quality hex and Torx bits in a neat PFAS-free fold-up travel case, with the whole package weighing in at just 278g.

Pneuma CC floor pump

£100 | Buy now

The Pneuma CC’s bold design certainly catches the eye but there’s plenty of substance to back up the style. It’s a premium floor pump – complete with long hose, wide steel base and easy-to-read gauge – but it also houses an internal air cannister that can deliver a burst of high-pressure air to seat a tubeless tyre. It can even help lift your bike when paired with Feedback Sports’ Pro Air Lift repair stand. Finally, a concealed storage space in the handle is handy for keeping additional tools within easy reach.

For more information about the full range of Feedback Sports products, go to ison-distribution.com
